Method of Attack: Malware downloader with multiple stages to establish foothold, initiate communications with attacker-controlled infrastructure, and implement loader functionality
Anti-analysis mechanisms including sandbox and virtual machine detection to evade analysis
Obfuscation techniques such as character replacement and runtime mathematical calculations to reconstruct PowerShell instructions
Display of decoy PDF documents during infection to distract victims
Locale-based kill switch terminating malware if system language is Romanian or from China, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus locales
Bot registration and unique ID generation per system
Fallback command-and-control (C2) domain retrieval with time-based fluxing for failback communication
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running PowerShell and VBS scripts
Attack Vector: Malspam campaigns delivering VBS scripts that initiate infection
Indicators of Compromise: Use of fallback C2 domains generated based on system date
Decoy PDF documents displayed during infection
Locale-based kill switch targeting Romanian, Chinese, Russian, Ukrainian, Belarus locales
